questions: qoute list filter by sales rep
filter quotes by sales rep
how do i see one sales rep's quotes
how to see quotes of a sales rep
answer:
1. Open **Quotes**.
2. Click **All Quotes**.
3. Type the sales rep's name in the search box: it matches the **Salesperson**.

**My Quotes** lists your own quotes.

questions: how to change the quantity of an area to 2
how to change the quantity of an area
how do i change area quantity
answer:
1. Open the quote and click **Edit drawing**.
2. Go to **6 Price Details**.
3. Click the area's pencil → **Edit Area**.
4. Set **Quantity** (a whole number, 1 or more; the area's subtotal is multiplied by it) → **Save**.
5. **Save** the drawing.

questions: how do i override the fabrication price for one line
change the price on one line of the quote
how do i change the price on one line
override a price on a quote
answer:
1. Open the quote and click **Edit drawing**.
2. Go to **6 Price Details**.
3. Click the underlined **@ price** of the line.
4. In **Override Price List**, type the new unit price → **Save**.
5. **Save** the drawing.

The override applies to that line in that color option only. To go back to the list price, clear the box and **Save**. Gray prices can't be changed.

questions: did the customer open my quote
did the customer open the quote
can i see if the customer opened my quote
can i see if the customer opened the quote email
answer:
Yes. On the quote's page, its emails are listed with **Views**: how many times the customer opened that email's link (click it to see each open with its time and device).

In the **Quotes** list, the **Email Viewed** column shows the last time any emailed link was opened.

questions: how to text the quote link
how do i text the quote to my customer
how do i text a quote
send quote by text
answer:
There is no text button or copyable link for a quote:
1. Open the quote and click **Print** → save the PDF.
2. In **CRM > SMS**, open the customer's conversation → paperclip → **Upload from computer** → pick the PDF → send.

To let the customer sign online, **Email** the quote instead.

questions: customer says the quote link is no longer active
the quote link is no longer active
quote link not active
answer: Someone turned off that email's link (**Deactivate link**). Open the quote, find that email in its list → **Activate link**, or send a new email.

questions: how to move a seam
move a seam
how do i move a seam
answer:
1. Open the quote → **Edit drawing** → step **5 Color & Edge** → the area's **Slabs & Layout**.
2. Click the piece → **Define Seams…**.
3. Remove the seam: hover it and click it, or the trash next to **Seam #1**….
4. Click where the new seam goes. Arrow keys move the yellow seam 1/16" (**Shift**: 1"); **Enter** places it.
5. **Save** the drawing.

questions: how to add a radius corner
how do i add a radius corner
how to round a corner
answer:
1. Open the quote → **Edit drawing** → step **2 Curves & Bumpouts**.
2. Click the corner's label.
3. Pick **Radius…** (the inner corner of an L or U: **Inside Radius…**).
4. Type the radius in **Edit Corner** → **Save**.
5. **Save** the drawing.

questions: where do i put the measurements from the template
where do i enter the template measurements
how do i type exact dimensions for a counter
answer:
1. Open the quote → **Edit drawing** → step **1 Counter Dimensions**.
2. Click a side's gray measurement number → **Edge Length**.
3. Type **Length** → **Save** (**Save & Next Edge** goes round the piece). The short end of a leg is its depth.
4. **Save** the drawing.

questions: customer wants a cheaper option in the same quote
show customer quartz and granite in the same quote
how do i give the customer two color options in one quote
answer:
1. Open the quote → **Edit drawing** → step **5 Color & Edge**.
2. Click **Add color option** (it starts as a copy of the last one).
3. On the new **Option** card, pick the other product and color.
4. **Save** the drawing.

Each option has its own slab layout and its own total.

questions: quote shows no price for the color what do i do
a line shows no price
why is a price missing on my quote
answer:
Open the quote → **Edit drawing** → **6 Price Details** and read the red reason under the line:
- *No Product selected.* / *No Color selected.* → pick them on step **5 Color & Edge**.
- *Special order: enter a price per sq ft.* → type it in the **Special order** box under **Color**.
- *Add slabs in the slab layout.* → **Slabs & Layout**.
- *No fabrication price for …* → an admin sets it in the price list (**Fabrication & install**).

Then **Save** the drawing.

questions: how do i drag a deal to won
drag deal to won
mark deal won
how do i mark a deal as won
answer:
**Won** is a status, not a column:
1. Open **CRM > Deals** and click the deal.
2. On the **Project** tab, click **Won**.

questions: how to reopen a lost deal
how do i reopen a won deal
reopen a deal
answer:
1. In **CRM > Deals**, switch **Status** to **Lost** (or **Won**) to find the deal.
2. Open it → **Project** tab → **Move to Active**.

The deal goes back to its stage.

questions: how to pin a note
how do i pin a note
answer:
1. Open the deal.
2. In the activity panel's **History** (**All** or **Notes**), hover the note.
3. Click **Pin**. Pinned notes stay on top with an amber background.

questions: how do i edit a note
edit a note
how to delete a note
answer:
1. Open the deal.
2. In the activity panel's **History** (**All** or **Notes**), hover the note.
3. Click the **pencil**, change the text → **Save** (the trash deletes it: **Delete Note** → **Delete**).

questions: how do i add the square footage and stone to a deal
where do i put the invoice amount on the deal
answer:
Deals have no stone, square-footage or invoice-amount fields:
- One number on the card: **General** tab → **Amount**.
- More detail (stone, square footage, invoiced amounts): add a **note** in the deal's activity panel.
- A short label such as "Misterio 45 sqft" can go in **General** → **Title**.
- To price the job, build a quote (**Quotes** tab).

questions: how to see the emails with the customer inside the deal
where are the emails in a deal
answer: Open the deal and click an email or text row in **History** (or the envelope / **SMS** button on the **Project** tab): the conversation opens over the deal.

questions: where is my to do list
to do list
answer: Click **Todo List** in the header: it's your personal list. A deal's own tasks are its activities, in that deal's activity panel.

questions: how to collapse the sidebar
collapse sidebar
the sidebar keeps closing
answer: Click **Pin** / **Pinned** below the sidebar sections (or press **Ctrl+B**). Unpinned, the sidebar shrinks to icons and slides open when you point at it; pinned, it stays open.

questions: how to restart a tour
restart a tour
how do i start a tour again
answer: **Dashboard** → **Onboarding** widget → click the tour's row under **Tours**. A tour you closed won't start by itself again.

questions: i deleted a customer by accident
how to restore a deleted customer
undo delete customer
answer: There is no undo button in the app. Nothing is permanently deleted, though: the customer and their deals are only hidden from all lists and boards.

questions: how do i send an email tomorrow at 8am
schedule an email
how to schedule an email to send later
answer:
1. In **CRM > Emails**, open the conversation and write the email.
2. Click the clock next to **Send** (**Send later**).
3. Pick the day and **Time**.
4. Click **Schedule**.

The **Send Email** window for a brand-new email has no clock: it sends right away.

questions: do calls count as activity
are calls saved as activities
answer: Not on the deal: calls aren't saved as activities or notes (use **Add note** or **Add Activity** on the call row). CloudTalk calls show in **Admin > Users Activity** (needs the rep's **CloudTalk agent ID**), and outgoing calls earn call points when the leaderboard is on.

questions: can i send the estimate confirmation by text and email both
send confirmation by text and email
answer: Yes. When you create or edit the event, in its **Notifications** box tick a text and an email template under **Send a confirmation now**, then save the event.

questions: why didnt the customer get the reminder
why didn't the customer get a reminder
customer did not get the reminder
answer:
A reminder isn't sent when:
- the event has no linked customer (a typed name gets nothing),
- the event repeats,
- the send time had already passed when it was booked,
- a variable can't be filled.

Texts also need a user with the **Office Manager** position who has a texting line.

questions: how do contractors see prices
contractors portal link
answer: In the contractors portal: take your showroom address, change `/customer/` to `/contractors/`, and send it to the contractor. No button in the CRM opens it.

questions: why cant i see company settings
why can't i see company settings
answer: **Company settings > Users** and **Company** need Admin access and the **Manager** position; **Billing** needs only the **Manager** position. Ask a Manager to change your positions in **Admin > Company settings > Users**.

questions: edit an invoice
how do i edit an invoice
answer:
1. **CRM > Customers** → open the customer.
2. **Company info** → **QuickBooks** section → **Get invoices**.
3. Click the **pencil** on the invoice → change it in **Edit invoice** → save to QuickBooks.

questions: how do i mark a slab as cut
mark slab cut
answer:
1. **Transactions** → open the sale (**Transaction Details**).
2. Click **Cut** on the slab's row: it's marked cut with today's date (**Uncut** reverses it).

Shop staff do it in the shop portal.

questions: add a room to a transaction
replace a slab on a sale
how do i add a room to a sale
answer:
1. **Inventory > Stones** → open the stone's slab list.
2. Click **Edit** on the sold (red) slab.
3. Change the rooms and slabs (**Add Room** for another room).
4. Click **Submit**.

Admins can also use **Admin > Transactions** → the sale's details (**Add Room**, **Add Slab**, **Replace**).

questions: where is the customer sales page
customer sales page
answer: It has no sidebar item: open `/employee/customers/view/<customer number>` on your Granite Manager address.

questions: where do i see my commissions
my commissions
answer: Commissions have no sidebar link at the moment: open `/employee/commissions` (admins: `/admin/quotes/commissions`).

questions: shop statistic page
where is shop statistic
answer: **Shop Statistic** is not in the sidebar: open `/shop/statistics` on your Granite Manager address. Shop Workers and employees can open it.

questions: how do i add a signature field to the form
add a signature field to the form
answer: You don't need to: contract forms get a **Customer Signature** line and a **Date** line at the end automatically, where the customer signs when the contract is sent for signature.

questions: how to add a new lead source
add a lead source
answer: Admins: in the **Add Customer** (or edit) form, click **Manage** next to **Source** → type in **New source** → **Add**.

questions: how do i create a project
how do i make multiple jobs under 1 customer
several jobs for one customer
answer:
- Several jobs for the same customer: add a deal for each job (**CRM > Deals** → **Add Deal** → pick the same customer).
- A builder with job sites: add each site as its own customer, then open the builder's **Customer Information** (**CRM > Customers** → its row) → **Projects** tab → **Search to link existing customer...** → **Link Customer**.

questions: how to open customer information from a deal
open customer information
answer: Not from inside the deal: go to **CRM > Customers** and click the customer's row (or a name in **Find Customer** there). Inside the deal, the **Project** tab shows the customer's details.
